description.value: Marmalade Bakery is a specialty bakery operating inside Skaha Pizza at the Yorkton Plaza on Skaha Lake Rd in Penticton, offering custom celebration cakes, cupcakes, and freshly baked daily goods. They also stock grab-and-go lunch items and specialty coffees and teas, making it a convenient mid-ride food stop near Skaha Lake. Vegan and gluten-free options are woven throughout the menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Marmalade Bakery is an active specialty bakery at 3450 Skaha Lake Rd in Penticton's Yorkton Plaza, operating inside Skaha Pizza; the contact page provides a confirmed physical address and email. The site lists custom cakes, cupcakes, vegan/gluten-free options, daily baked goods, grab-and-go lunch items, and specialty coffees and teas, establishing it as a real and open food business. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so all such fields are null.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists Mo-Sa but website contact page explicitly states closed Sunday and Monday (Tuesday–Saturday only) — OSM incorrectly includes Monday.
Minor internal website discrepancy: front page states open until 4pm, contact page states until 3pm.
Physical address (3450 Skaha Lake Rd, Penticton, BC) is confirmed on website but absent from the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active bakery with a working website, confirmed physical address, and online shop; a useful food stop for touring cyclists near Skaha Lake.
enrichment_extras.notes: Located inside Skaha Pizza at the Yorkton Plaza. Contact email from website: marmaladebakerypenticton@gmail.com.
